{{Otheruses|Teeth}}
'''To the Teeth''' was a weapon shop located in [[Point Nadir]]. It was owned by [[Yalpor Waar]] and was one of the most respected and well-stocked shops in the [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]]. It was said almost any weapon up to a capital-scale [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] could be purchased in the shop. Most weapons and explosives could be delivered in an hour, but exotic weapons might take a day to procure.<ref name="Scum and Villainy">[[Scum and Villainy (sourcebook)|''Scum and Villainy'']]</ref>

It was only open a few [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] a [[Standard day/Legends|day]] each morning, but Yalpor would meet special customers after hours if they made appointments. The shop was located in a large warehouse in the [[Trade District]].<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />
